versions.content: In case the Dem_J1939DcmSetRatioFilter, Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter or Dem_J1939DcmSetFreezeFrameFilter returns E_OK and the ‘FreezeFrameKind’ is set to ‘ DEM_J1939DCM_FREEZEFRAME ’ or ’ DEM_J1939DCM_EXPANDED_FREEZEFRAME ’, t he J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939D cmGetNextFreezeFrame, till the return ed value is ‘ DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT ’. The calls may spread over several calls of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.
